name: net_session_config_dialog_destructor
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::Destructor tears down the session-configuration MFC dialog controls in the recovered order. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja still shows MSVC EH registration scaffolding around the destructor sequence, but the destruction body and object layout are verified.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41c7f0 validates destruction of CString at 0x168, map combo at 0x128, time/value/max spin controls at 0xe8/0xa8/0x68, then the CDialog base, followed by return.
The native smoke constructs the dialog, patches CString, CComboBox, CSpinButtonCtrl, and CDialog destructors, then verifies the recovered destruction order and exact object addresses.
